**LASER** stands for **L**ight **A**mplification by **S**timulated **E**mission of **R**adiation.

| Feature | Spontaneous Emission | Stimulated Emission |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Definition** | An excited atom drops to a lower state spontaneously without external trigger. | An incident photon triggers an excited atom to drop, releasing a secondary photon. |
| **Phase/Direction** | Emitted photons are out of phase and travel in random directions. | Emitted photons are in phase (coherent) and travel in the same direction. |
| **Basis of** | Ordinary light sources (e.g., bulb, LED). | Laser action. |
